text:
Nina: quick game: spot the three sins in this YAML and you win eternal glory (and one bagel). :trophy: :bagel:
Tim: do we accept 'eternal glory' as a valid budget item? :money_with_wings:
Nina: here's the crime scene:
```yaml
service:
  name: "compat-checker"
	replicas: 2
version: v1.0.0-beta..1
env:
  - KEY=VALUE
```
Rina: oof. mixed indent (tab + two spaces), semver has a stray `..`, and uh, list under env should be mapping or quoted. classic triple threat. :grimacing:
Tim: also `v` prefix plus `beta..1` is suspiciously artistic. semver is now performance art. :art:
Dev-Bot: lint-suggest: replace tabs with 2 spaces; normalize env to mapping; validate semver against regex. :robot_face:
CI-Bot: build #2045 failed: yaml indentation error at line 3; semver parse error at `version`
Nina: bet: whoever pushed this was trying to summon a compiler demon. :imp:
Rina: small poll: do we (1) fix and move on, (2) immortalize in a "Hall of Shame" doc, or (3) make a sticker? React with :one:/:two:/:three:
Tim: :one: (fix) but I'm voting :three: for the sticker if we can wear it during standups. :laughing:
Nina: consensus: fix first, then sticker design meeting. Also consequence: the committer brings bagels. :ok_hand:
Dev-Bot: triggered pipeline fix/remove-sneaky-dots; running linter...
CI-Bot: pipeline #2046 passed after removing the extra dot and converting tab to spaces. passing tests. :white_check_mark:
Rina: victory bagels confirmed. also someone please write a haiku: "YAML whispers soft / semver dreams in dotted sleep / linter brings dawn" :scroll:
Tim: I'll craft the haiku and the sticker mockup. Nina, expect a PR and a bagel invoice. :coffee:
